what: A small character walks from outside the panel’s right edge to the left end in step with progress — its position follows .3s late (power3), progress is split into 24 steps and each step change toggles two frames (footfall) alternately, so the legs move only while scrolling. A progress indicator laid under a fixed section that shows how far you’ve come as footsteps

options.frames: Number of steps progress is split into for swapping images, default 24
options.scrub: Seconds the position lags behind, default .3 — 0 means immediately
options.dir: If right, goes from outside the left edge to the right end (flips the image), default is to the left
options.drive: With event, it does not measure itself but follows fx:progress (detail.progress 0~1) sent to the element — for tying to the progress of a pinned section
options.area: Panel passed through when measuring itself (ancestor selector), default parent

from.where: index.html .sm-about__walker — a little kid who walks along the bottom of the screen from off the right edge to the left end while the About paper panel is pinned (4 screens) (right -96px → 100%, scrub .3, 24 frames, two images)

note: The picture changes only when the cell changes, so when it stops the feet stop too. The original uses the first picture at the first cell (0), alternates odd/even from cell 1, and after the end holds the (frames−1) cell picture
